title: The Vault's Stone
journal: The second seal-stone lies in the lowest hall of the Vaults of Gemin, which is under water. The dead walk the vaults and a wraith guards the last hall, and Unbound may be searching there. I'm to go down and take it. I can fight through, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin. (marker: Seal-Stone of the Kings, Gemin)
Read the Tablet of the Kings beside the stone. (marker: Tablet of the Kings)

plan.going: I am hunting the three seal-stones for the Toh-Reel-Ka; this one is in Gemin's drowned lowest hall
plan.next: go down through the vaults to the lowest hall and take the stone; read the tablet beside it
plan.ways: fight the Unbound, the dead and the wraith; slip past them (Sneak); turn the dead and the wraith (Restoration); I must swim the last hall, or carry waterbreathing

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka as a Reel-Ka. I must gather three seal-stones that open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire so I can use the Eye of Argonia at the Root to heal the sick Hist trees. I already hold the Seal-Stone of the Kings from Blackrose Prison. Now I am at Gemin for the second stone.
Take the seal-stone from the drowned lowest hall of Gemin, and read the Tablet of the Kings beside it.
Fight through the dead, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration. There is a Warden of the Vaults, an Unbound Rearguard and Restless Dead here.
I do not fully understand what the Warden of the Vaults wants, why Unbound are here, or what the Tablet says. I can find out by talking to the Warden and reading the tablet.

title: The Vault's Stone
journal: I took the second seal-stone from the drowned hall of Gemin. The tablet beside it says why the kings sealed the Root. Lifted, the Eye parts every tree from every other; used where it sits, it strengthens them. Two stones are still out, in Blackrose Prison and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked.

answers: Notes: I took the second seal-stone (Seal-Stone of the Kings, Gemin) without a fight; nobody would talk. I now hold two stones (Blackrose and Gemin), plus the Warden Vault Key. The Tablet says: the Eye at the Root, used where it sits, strengthens every Hist tree; lifted from its place, it cuts every tree off from every other and the weak die alone. So I must USE it in place, never lift it. Still to get: the Vorannuhl stone (deepest hall, boat near Noota Nara); the journal also oddly still lists Blackrose as marked, though I have that stone. Then dive from Bell Station off Lilmoth to Teku-Sul gate. Open questions: Fort Chalkmoth cellar moan and key, how Nesh-Deeka knows the Unbound, why Cuts-the-Old-Knot seals trees she drains (maybe she wants the Eye lifted).
